text: Varnholt Logistics appointed Dorian Feltz as chief executive in March, according to a company filing reviewed by The Continental Record and a board resolution dated March 14. The appointment took effect immediately after the departure of Elna Quist, who had led the freight group for seven years. In the filing, Varnholt said Feltz would oversee a five-year expansion plan centered on rail terminals, cold-chain storage and digital customs services. The board cited his 18 years in transport finance, including a recent role as managing director of Brask & Vale Capital. Varnholt reported revenue of 2.8 billion crowns last year and said Feltz would be eligible for a performance package worth up to 4.6 million crowns annually.
